# Deny rules win over allow rules. These apply to every persona.
Edit
Write
MultiEdit
NotebookEdit
WebFetch
WebSearch
Task
# Block credential exfiltration through the AWS CLI: a custom endpoint would
# receive signed requests (including the session token), --debug prints them.
Bash(*--endpoint-url*)
Bash(*--debug*)
Bash(*--ca-bundle*)
Bash(*--no-verify-ssl*)
Bash(aws configure *)
# The persona role can invoke Bedrock for Claude Code itself; the agent's
# shell must not call models or mint other credentials with it.
Bash(aws bedrock*)
Bash(aws sts assume-role*)
Bash(aws sts get-session-token*)
Bash(aws sts get-federation-token*)
# No reading the credentials from the environment.
Bash(env*)
Bash(printenv*)
Bash(*AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY*)
Bash(*AWS_SESSION_TOKEN*)
Bash(*/proc/*)
# Credential and process files on the runner.
Read(~/.aws/**)
Read(//home/runner/.aws/**)
Read(//proc/**)
